placements.why: Establishes the foundational category for memory ingestion, slug generation, and file commit mechanisms.
placements.title: Automated ingestion, resolution, and commit infrastructure for memory artifacts
placements.frame: How does the platform structure pipelines to ingest, identify, and persist memory submissions reliably?

placements.title: Fallback-driven slug derivation ensures robust memory commits when identifiers are omitted
placements.frame: How does the ingestion pipeline guarantee consistent identity resolution and successful file commits in the absence of explicit identifiers?
placements.why: src-1 identifies the condition of omitted id fields, and src-2 establishes the requirement for the pipeline to resolve a slug via LLM id-gen or deterministic fallback and successfully commit the file.
